about: Reviewed status and headline of each experiment. The research API serves the newest experiment of a study that is not superseded, with this review; artifacts themselves are git-ignored and regenerated by the commands in docs/research/results.md. Edit only after reading the experiment's metrics.json.

F1-20261021T190101Z.reason: seasonal-naive baseline repeated weeks k seasons back for horizons beyond 7 days (audit F01); baseline comparisons, champion selection and the 'trained models beat the baseline' claim are invalid

S1-20261021T193239Z.reason: replayed the defective seasonal-naive baseline (F01); its q90 policy choice was informed by the test window and is exploratory (S20)

R2-20261021T191153Z.reason: the 'temporal logic off vs on' contrast changed effective-date filtering and reranking at once (audit S13)

R2-20261022T045503Z.headline: Effective-date filtering and supersession reranking each remove wrong-version citations; together they reach 100%
R2-20261022T045503Z.notes: 2x2 factorial on 118 synthetic questions (not human-reviewed): temporal main effect +3.2 points, rerank main effect +4.2 points, interaction +0.9 points. Measures the mechanism, not real-world contract understanding.

R1-20261021T191153Z.headline: On ACORD, vector search beats the hybrid — a negative result we keep
R1-20261021T191153Z.notes: Absolute scores are low and were not compared with published ACORD baselines.

C1-20261021T191800Z.headline: Hybrid search finds the expert-labelled clause most often within a contract

IB-20261021T192006Z.headline: SupplyLens policy scores highest of three tool-only policies on InventoryBench
IB-20261021T192006Z.notes: Deterministic policies only; does not use the forecasting models affected by F01.

AGT-20261021T192432Z.reason: recorded before the session-4 dispatch, read-back and budget corrections

AGT-20261022T045832Z.headline: Investigator: every frozen scenario verified, zero unapproved external writes
AGT-20261022T045832Z.notes: 57 scenarios x 3 trials on the corrected code (lookup-first retry, full read-back, explicit zero budget). Deterministic control regression, not a model-capability result.
